caption:
How to turn a messy calendar and to-do list into a realistic weekly plan with AI

Your calendar shows the appointments, not the quotes, invoices and callbacks around them. That's why they land on Sunday night.

Copy this:

"Here's my week: fixed appointments plus a to-do list. Build a realistic Mon–Fri plan. Rules: deadline tasks first, group similar tasks, leave a buffer every day, protect personal plans, and list anything that should move to next week. My week: [PASTE APPOINTMENTS + TO-DOS]"

I tried it on an invented house painter's week. It bought the paint before it was needed, called leads early, kept Wednesday evening free for a school play, and moved the website photos to next week.

The whole thing took about 5 minutes, including reading the plan.
